## 2. WHAT NAYA POWER IS

Naya Power is a **personal intelligence operating system** that turns a reactive AI conversation into a continuously guided project-execution system. It exists so an ordinary human with a meaningful vision can accomplish extraordinary things **without becoming an AI project manager**.

- **North Star:** maximum verified human value per unit of effort, with compounding intelligence and continuity.
- **Core loop (Hub):** CAPTURE → DISTILL → ORGANIZE → REMEMBER → FIND → COMPOUND.
- **Hub mission:** INTELLIGENCE MADE VISIBLE.
- **Model:** Human Authority + AI Intelligence. GitHub is the durable project brain; the Intelligent Hub is the cockpit that projects that brain to a human.

The human gives the mission once. Naya restores the project, understands the real state, takes the highest-value authorized action, verifies reality, records the learning, and passes the torch.

## 4. HOW IT ALL CONNECTS

### 4.1 The intelligence loop

```
HUMAN EXPERIENCE
   → SMART NOTE (one event, many human views)
   → PIS (GitHub intake/index)          [docs 15, 45]
   → CIS (compounding)                  [doc 16]
   → ADAPTIVE LEARNING (behavior change)[doc 17]
   → SUPERBRAIN (model+memory+laws)     [doc 19]
   → APPLICATION (Intelligent Hub)      [docs 32, 40, 52]
   → OUTCOME
   → VERIFY                             [docs 51, 55]
   → NEW LEARNING → CONTINUATION        [docs 16, 58]
```

### 4.2 The Hub pipeline (canonical)

```
CANONICAL INTELLIGENCE
   → INTELLIGENT EVENT
   → SMART NOTE
   → INTELLIGENT BLOCK                  [doc 42]
   → SMART FEED                         [doc 43]
   → HUMAN UNDERSTANDING
   → HUMAN ACTION
   → NEW EVENT
   → VERIFICATION                       [docs 51, 55]
   → UPDATED INTELLIGENCE
   → CONTINUATION
```

**Non-negotiable:** the Hub is a **projection surface, never a source of truth**. GitHub is the source. The Hub renders what GitHub holds.

### 4.3 The user's exact scenario

> Human says **"make me a smart note."**
> → Naya writes the note in its 9 human views (doc 03).
> → It is pushed to **GitHub PIS** (doc 15) via the **GitHub App bridge** (doc 53) / direct-write architecture (doc 44).
> → The human receives a **Smart Link receipt** (doc 48) — a durable link they can open.
> → The note appears as an **Intelligent Block** on the **feed** (docs 40, 43).
> → Future retrieval surfaces it by meaning (doc 50).
> All inside the **Ultimate Trust Loop** (doc 58).

3. **Phase 2 — Make intelligence real.** Smart Note → Intelligent Block (doc 42) → PIS adapter (doc 45); cross-system event contract (doc 39).

5. **Phase 4 — Make the Hub living.** Realtime (doc 49), Spaces (doc 47), Smart Links (doc 48), search (doc 50).

**Executor contract per slice:**
`INTERVIEWER → ARCHITECT → BUILDER → OBSERVER → VERIFIER → TEACHER → SUCCESSOR`
`DEFINE → INSPECT → EXTRACT → RECONCILE → PRESERVE → ELEVATE → BUILD → LOOK → CLICK → TEST → MOBILE → VERIFY → LOCK → NEXT`

Use the **smallest coherent high-value vertical slice**. Never blindly patch a failed presentation. Never create a parallel implementation when a canonical one exists.

## 8. CONTINUITY CONTRACT — LEAVE A BATON, NOT A DEAD END

Every substantive execution must end with the canonical final output:

```
RESULT → VERIFICATION → CURRENT STATE → LESSON → NEXT ACTION → NAYA → NEXT EXECUTION PROMPT
```

**EXECUTION BATON (fill real values, no placeholders):**

```
Mission
Current State
Verified Progress
Protected State
Work Completed
Evidence
Failures / Unknowns
Latest Lesson
Highest-Value Gap
Authorized Next Action
Required Evidence
Source / HEAD
Relevant Workflow / Runtime
Verification Requirements

```

**NO-ORPHAN TEST before ending:**

> If I disappeared right now and a completely cold Naya inherited only the canonical repository and recorded state, could she execute the next action correctly without asking what happened?

If NO, the execution is incomplete. Strengthen the state, record, proof, or baton before ending.

Record the durable receipt in the Activity Feed (`SUPERBRAIN/NAYA-ACTIVITY/DAILY/<date>.md`), update the canonical state, and expose **exactly one** executable next action.
